commits.author: Franz Hemmer
commits.message:
feat: implement custom title bar with zoom scaling

- Create custom HTML title bar component that scales with zoom
- Remove native Electron menu and window frame
- Add frameless window with custom drag region
- Implement window controls (minimize, maximize, close) via IPC
- Add beautiful HemSoft branding with golden gradient text
- Menu dropdowns with VSCode-style dark theme
- Zoom keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+Num+, Ctrl+Num-, Ctrl+Num0)
- Window controls positioned at top-right

Benefits:
- Title bar now scales with zoom level (part of web content)
- Consistent cross-platform appearance
- Modern, polished UI matching reference app
- Better integration with app theme

commits.author: Franz Hemmer
commits.message:
feat: implement tree view navigation

- Create TreeView component with expandable/collapsible groups
- Add tree structure for Pull Requests, Skills, Tasks, and Insights
- VSCode-style dark theme with proper hover and selection states
- Chevron icons for expand/collapse functionality
- Icon support using lucide-react
- Tree preserves expansion state
- Matches hs-conductor visual style

Initial tree structure:
- Pull Requests (My PRs, Needs Review, Recently Merged)
- Skills (Browse Skills, Recently Used, Favorites)
- Tasks (Today, Upcoming, Projects)
- Insights (Productivity, Activity)

commits.author: Franz Hemmer
commits.message:
feat: add zoom persistence and disable DevTools auto-open

- Remove automatic DevTools opening in development mode
- Persist zoom level across app restarts in userData/zoom-config.json
- Track current zoom factor in memory for smooth updates
- Apply saved zoom level on window load
- Window position and size already persisted via electron-window-state

Changes:
- Zoom level saved to: app.getPath('userData')/zoom-config.json
- Zoom persists between sessions (range: 0.5x to 3.0x)
- DevTools now only opens via menu or keyboard shortcut
